ignored.reason: the token name itself is the copy target, in Plex Mono at body size; a DS Button would restyle the name. The DS copy button beside it does the same job
the whole contrast row (tile, pair, ratio, Badge) is one target that opens the token drawer; the DS has no row button and Button would truncate it to one label
the whole token row (swatches, name, light and dark values) is one target that selects it; the DS has no row button and Button would truncate it to one label
the whole card (drawing, title, line) is one target that opens its step, as on the validated board; the DS ChoiceCard is a radio (select, then confirm) and Button would cut it to one label
an interactive stepper (each step a button that opens that difference, with its verdict); the DS Stepper is a static path
a step of the stepper (its state mark and its name) is one target; the DS has no stepper and Button would cut it to one label
the last step of the stepper, the same target as the others
an outlined region drawn over the picture at the measured place, with its number; no DS control is a positioned outline
a mark on the small map at the measured place, a mouse shortcut only (the list is the keyboard path); no DS control is a positioned outline
the whole line is the way into that difference (CTA 1), its keyboard stop too; a DS Link would underline the row. "Look at N" repeats it for the pointer.
the whole capture is one link to its version (a block with a scrim and a pill on hover); DS Link styles inline text with an underline, so a block link is requested in the PR
the small picture is the target that opens the whole capture; the DS has no image button and Button would draw a label around it
a map box is one toggle target holding a name and a line under it; the DS has no toggle card and Button would cut it to one label
the whole piece row (title, who asked, its state) is one target that shows the piece, like the review queue rows; the DS has no row button and Button would cut it to one label
the whole step row (mark, title, detail, status) is one target that opens the step, like the review queue rows; the DS has no row button and Button would truncate it to one label
the whole product row (name, run, two meters, chevron) is one link target, like the Explorations rows; a DS Link would underline every part of the row
a side nav group opener styled as its sibling nav links (with the review count badge and chevron); the DS SidebarNav is a React island and would rebuild the whole rail
hidden file picker behind the DS Button "Attach an image"; the DS has no file input
an 8px dot in the color of a contrast verdict, the legend key of the table's marks; a dot with no text, not a Tag, and the DS status dot only exists inside Badge
a drawing of a Drawer on a thumbnail plate (inert, aria-hidden), not a drawer; the DS Drawer is a modal portal and cannot sit in a thumbnail
the bar of the interactive stepper of BuildReview (each step a button that opens that difference); the DS Stepper is a static path, see the same exception in BuildReview.tsx

a token specimen, an inert aria-hidden miniature that shows one token at work; it is drawn from the documented system's own tokens (a team's tokens on its Library), so it cannot be a Bridge DS component
